title: Drupal Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying and serving the Drupal CMS web application.

DRUPAL_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: PHP-FPM FastCGI socket path or host:port endpoint executing Drupal PHP requests.

DRUPAL_DB_TYPE.description: Database backend driver for Drupal (e.g., mysql, pgsql, sqlite).

DRUPAL_DB_NAME.description: Database schema name provisioned for the Drupal site.

DRUPAL_DB_USER.description: Database username used by Drupal for database connections.

DRUPAL_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem webroot directory where Drupal core and modules are installed.

DRUPAL_SERVER_NAME.description: Virtual host domain name configured for the Drupal web server.

DRUPAL_VERSION.description: Target Drupal core version or semantic alias (e.g., latest) to deploy.

DRUPAL_DB_PASS.description: Password authenticating the Drupal database user.

DRUPAL_WEBSERVER.description: Frontend web server fronting Drupal (e.g., nginx, caddy, httpd).

DRUPAL_LISTEN.description: HTTP listen address:port or UNIX socket exposed by the Drupal web server.

db_strategy.description: Database provisioning strategy (local managed instance vs remote server).

db_url.description: Full database connection string or URL.
